_comment: pump.fun fee sharing allows up to 10 recipients, each a normal wallet pubkey (SOL sent directly on distribute).
share_bps are basis points; they MUST sum to exactly 10000. Default: 100% to the puzzle wallet.
The puzzle wallet is read from public-commitment.json unless you set it explicitly below.
Example of an optional buyback/burn share so the project survives after someone wins (see README point 5).
